records.title: STATUS OF EKLAVYA MODEL RESIDENTIAL SCHOOLS
details:
(a): Accordingly, Ministry has set the target to set up total of 728 EMRSs benefiting around 3.5 lakh ST students across the country. As on date, 715 schools have been sanctioned, out of which 476 EMRSs have been reported to be functional across the country benefiting about 1,33,929 students. 
(b) & (c): A total of 108 locations have been sanctioned and formal sanction at 06 locations is pending for want of encumbrance/encroachment free land by 
State Government.
